IMPORTANT:
The source project deliberately does not scrape/bypass Sketchfab authentication. Import the legitimately downloaded FBX/GLB packages into this folder, then assign them to the LocustAI and BoiledOneEncounter prefabs. Keep attribution required by each asset license and verify the model page license before redistribution.
